nodes.name: Site Enquiry Webhook
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/site-enquiry. Called only by apps/marketing-site/api/lead.js, which has already checked Origin, honeypot, timing and shape. responseMode is 'responseNode' because the caller's HTTP status is load-bearing: lead.js answers the visitor 503 when this answers non-2xx.

nodes.name: Guard: Secret and Allowlist
nodes.notes: Refuses before reading the body. Expected value comes from $env.NEXUS_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET and is never stored in this file.

nodes.name: Authorized?
nodes.notes: TRUE -> compose and send. FALSE -> audit the refusal, then answer 401. typeVersion 2.2 matches the IF nodes used elsewhere in this system.

nodes.name: Email: Site Enquiry (Gmail)
nodes.notes: Node type, typeVersion 2.1 and the gmailOAuth2 credential reference (id 1Cgivoyjt7psAirH) are copied verbatim from n8n-workflows/lead_escalation_ai_agent.json so the import binds to the credential that already exists. onError is 'continueRegularOutput' ONLY so that a failure reaches the Delivery Report and an audit row; the next node checks it and the workflow answers 502. Do not remove the Delivery Report and leave this onError in place.

nodes.name: Delivery Report
nodes.notes: Turns the Gmail node's output into a claim we are willing to write down.

nodes.name: Actually Sent?
nodes.notes: TRUE -> audit SUCCESS, answer 200. FALSE -> audit FAILED, answer 502 so lead.js answers the visitor 503 and shows the WhatsApp fallback. A visitor must never be told an enquiry was delivered when it was not.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: 'Site Enquiry Notification', status: 'SUCCESS', lead_name: $json.enquiry.full_name, lead_email: $json.enquiry.email || null, summary: ('Site enquiry emailed via Gmail. dealership=' + ($json.enquiry.dealership || 'n/a') + ' stock_size=' + ($json.enquiry.stock_size || 'n/a') + ' phone=' + ($json.enquiry.phone || 'n/a') + ' submission_id=' + ($json.enquiry.submission_id || '(none)')).substring(0, 900), logged_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

nodes.name: Audit: SENT
nodes.notes: Shape copied from the 'Audit Log' node in n8n-workflows/lead_escalation_ai_agent.json (same URL, supabaseApi credential dv4OeARarErZLHCj, Prefer: return=minimal, jsonBody expression). tenant_id is omitted and falls to the column default nexus_default_tenant_id(), which is how all sixteen existing workflows write this table -- see GO-LIVE.md, 'What I could not settle'.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: 'Site Enquiry Notification', status: 'FAILED', lead_name: $json.enquiry.full_name, lead_email: $json.enquiry.email || null, summary: ('SITE ENQUIRY NOT DELIVERED. reason=' + ($json.why || 'unknown') + ' | dealership=' + ($json.enquiry.dealership || 'n/a') + ' phone=' + ($json.enquiry.phone || 'n/a') + ' email=' + ($json.enquiry.email || 'n/a') + ' submission_id=' + ($json.enquiry.submission_id || '(none)') + ' | CONTACT THIS PERSON MANUALLY').substring(0, 900), logged_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

nodes.name: Audit: FAILED
nodes.notes: This is the row that matters. It carries enough of the enquiry to contact the person by hand, because the mail did not arrive and nothing else in the system knows they exist.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: 'Site Enquiry Notification', status: 'REFUSED', summary: ('Refused at the guard. reason=' + ($json.reason || 'unknown') + ' ip=' + ($json.ip || 'unknown')).substring(0, 900), logged_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

nodes.name: Audit: REFUSED
nodes.notes: No enquiry fields: the guard refused before parsing the body, and the presented secret is deliberately never logged. reason='guard_not_configured' means NEXUS_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset in n8n -- the workflow then refuses everything, which is the correct direction to fail.

nodes.name: Respond 200
nodes.notes: lead.js reads only r.ok, but the body says which branch answered.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'send_failed', detail: $('Delivery Report').first().json.why }) }}

nodes.name: Respond 502
nodes.notes: Non-2xx on purpose. lead.js turns any non-ok into a 503 'not_delivered' for the visitor.

nodes.name: Respond 401
nodes.notes: Same code and shape as 'Respond Unauthorized' in n8n-workflows/nexus_infra_health_probe.json.
